route: Visado Transeúnte Laboral (TR-L), authorised by the Interior Ministry

permit.first: the Interior Ministry's authorisation (no Labour Ministry permit for artists)

fees.what: Consular fee, TR-L visa (Embassy in Tokyo; paid in yen)

sources.title: Resolución Conjunta N° 364 (Interior y Justicia), 165 (Relaciones Exteriores), 0530 (Trabajo), Gaceta Oficial N° 5.427 Extraordinario de 5 de enero de 2000, Justia's copy; published in the Gaceta Oficial de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela N° 5.427 Extraordinario (no official text online found; SAIME's home page given)
sources.said: Artículo 36º- Visado Transeúnte Laboral (TR-L) Será de la competencia del Ministerio del Interior y Justicia, previa conformidad del Ministerio del Trabajo, la autorización del Visado de Transeúnte Laboral. … Parágrafo Unico: Se exceptúan los artistas, corresponsales de prensa extranjera y deportistas en actividades lucrativas, cuyos representantes en Venezuela deberán obtener solamente autorización del Ministerio del Interior y Justicia, el cual establecerá las condiciones del visado y el término de permanencia. … Artículo 38º- El Visado Transeúnte Laboral se otorgará con una vigencia de un (1) año, múltiples entradas, y permitirá una permanencia por igual período. Podrá ser prorrogado en el país por el Ministerio del Interior y Justicia por igual término

sources.title: Embassy of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela in Japan, 'Working Visa - TR-L' (page dated 2016-08-29)
sources.said: Exceptions: Artists, foreign press correspondents and sporting activity professionals engaged in profit-making activities are exempt, and their representatives in Venezuela must obtain the authorization of the Interior Justice and Peace Ministry only, which will establish the conditions for the visa and the duration period. This visa is granted for one (1) year with multiple entries. … • Payment of the consular fee USD 60.00, equivalent in yen.

note: The joint visa resolution of 2000 (Interior and Justice No. 364, Foreign Affairs No. 165, Labour No. 0530; Gaceta Oficial No. 5.427 Extraordinario, read in Justia's copy, whose text carries escaped markup stripped for reading): the TR-L visa runs a year, multiple entries, extendable in Venezuela for an equal term; artists in paid activities are excepted from the Labour Ministry's permit, their representatives in Venezuela needing only the Interior Ministry's authorisation, which sets the visa's conditions and the stay. Whether it still holds after the 2004 Ley de Extranjería y Migración wasn't confirmed (SAIME's and the Foreign Ministry's sites challenge this client, layer 3). No fee or decision time found. The USD 60 consular fee is the Embassy in Tokyo's, on a page dated 2016 that repeats the resolution's exception for artists; a current fee from the Foreign Ministry wasn't reached.
